selected_evidence.requirement: Cron job scheduled for 02:15 daily running inventory-maintenance and logging to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
selected_evidence.summary: Crontab entry '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' installed and verified via crontab -l; script fixed, made executable, test-run, and manually run once confirming log output
Captured boot_id, uptime, crond active status, crontab contents, script perms, and log content before reboot
Issued backgrounded systemctl reboot; command returned 'reboot-issued' before the node disconnected
Polling showed connection timeout, then reset, then success with a new boot_id (c9559b18-...) differing from baseline (4cee4ea8-...), proving the node actually rebooted

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of cron job, script, and log
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, crond active, crontab entry intact, script perms 755 root:root intact, log file content intact, and a fresh manual run appended a new timestamped line confirming continued functionality

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: rewrite script cleanly =="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance > /dev/null <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
printf 'inventory maintenance completed at %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
SCRIPT
sudo -n chown root:root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
sudo -n chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance

echo "== STEP 2: verify script content and perms =="
cat /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
stat -c '%a %U:%G' /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance

echo "== STEP 3: test run =="
sudo -n /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance

echo "== STEP 4: install crontab for root =="
CRONLINE='15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'
(sudo -n crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v inventory-maintenance || true; echo "$CRONLINE") | sudo -n crontab -

echo "== STEP 5: verify crontab installed =="
sudo -n crontab -l

echo "== STEP 6: confirm cron service active =="
systemctl is-active crond

echo "== STEP 7: manually run once to seed/verify log path works =="
sudo -n sh -c '/usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'
ls -la /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
cat /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
